title: SWE-DIVE: Multi-Turn Coding Agent Evaluation with Dynamic User Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30047v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are typically evaluated using one-shot, well-formulated prompts. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench use existing GitHub issues as input for a coding agent and evaluate whether the agent successfully solves the task. However, in real-world use cases, prompts are often not as well-formulated or structured as existing GitHub issues. Additionally, a coding agent session is not limited to a single prompt; it typically involves a multi-turn interaction in which the user iteratively adds new tasks and requirements that the agent must fulfill.   To benchmark these abilities, we developed SWE-DIVE, a dynamic, interactive validation and evaluation framework for benchmarking coding agents in a multi-turn environment. To achieve this, we introduce a user simulator that can simulate different behavioral patterns and communicate with the coding agent. translated_title: SWE-DIVE：基于动态用户模拟的多轮编程智能体评估
translated_abstract: 编程智能体通常使用一次性的、格式良好的提示词进行评估。诸如 SWE-bench 等基准测试使用现有的 GitHub issue 作为编程智能体的输入，并评估该智能体是否成功完成任务。然而，在现实世界的使用场景中，提示词往往不像现有的 GitHub issue 那样格式规范或结构清晰。此外，编程智能体会话并不局限于单个提示词；它通常涉及多轮交互，用户会在交互过程中迭代地添加智能体必须完成的新任务和需求。为了对这些能力进行基准测试，我们开发了 SWE-DIVE，这是一个动态的、交互式的验证与评估框架，用于在多轮环境中对编程智能体进行基准测试。为实现这一目标，我们引入了一个能够模拟不同行为模式并与编程智能体进行通信的用户模拟器。我们还引入了一个对话验证器，用于评估用户模拟器的输出以检（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 SWE-DIVE 框架，通过引入可模拟多种行为模式的动态用户模拟器和对话验证器，在多轮交互环境中评估编程智能体，弥补了传统单轮、格式规范提示词基准测试与真实使用场景之间的差距。
en_tdlr: SWE-DIVE is a dynamic, interactive benchmarking framework that evaluates coding agents in multi-turn environments by introducing a user simulator with diverse behavioral patterns and a conversation validator, bridging the gap between idealized one-shot benchmarks and real-world usage.
